import Std.Data.HashMap.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Complex.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic

noncomputable section

open Complex

structure CX where
  re : Float
  im : Float
deriving Repr

def CX.add (a b : CX) : CX := ⟨a.re + b.re, a.im + b.im⟩
def CX.sub (a b : CX) : CX := ⟨a.re - b.re, a.im - b.im⟩
def CX.mul (a b : CX) : CX := ⟨a.re * b.re - a.im * b.im, a.re * b.im + a.im * b.re⟩
def CX.mk (r i : Float) : CX := ⟨r, i⟩
def CX.normSq (c : CX) : Float := c.re * c.re + c.im * c.im

inductive EdgeQuality : Type where
  | superposition : EdgeQuality
  | entangled     : EdgeQuality
  | coherent      : EdgeQuality
  | collapsed     : EdgeQuality
  | fractal       : EdgeQuality
deriving Repr, BEq

def EdgeQuality.toVal : EdgeQuality → Nat
  | .superposition => 0
  | .entangled     => 1
  | .coherent      => 2
  | .collapsed     => 3
  | .fractal       => 4

def EdgeQuality.toString : EdgeQuality → String
  | .superposition => "superposition"
  | .entangled     => "entangled"
  | .coherent      => "coherent"
  | .collapsed     => "collapsed"
  | .fractal       => "fractal"

def EdgeQuality.fromString : String → Option EdgeQuality
  | "superposition" => some .superposition
  | "entangled"     => some .entangled
  | "coherent"      => some .coherent
  | "collapsed"     => some .collapsed
  | "fractal"       => some .fractal
  | _               => none

structure Qubit where
  a : CX
  b : CX
deriving Repr

def Qubit.normSquared (q : Qubit) : Float :=
  q.a.re * q.a.re + q.a.im * q.a.im + q.b.re * q.b.re + q.b.im * q.b.im

def Float.clamp01 (x : Float) : Float :=
  if x < 0.0 then 0.0 else if x > 1.0 then 1.0 else x

def Float.sqrt' (x : Float) : Float :=
  if x <= 0.0 then 0.0 else x.sqrt

def Qubit.normalize (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let ns := q.normSquared
  if ns <= 0.0 || ns.isNaN || ns.isInf
  then ⟨CX.mk 1.0 0.0, CX.mk 0.0 0.0⟩
  else
    let inv := 1.0 / Float.sqrt' ns
    let s := CX.mk inv 0.0
    ⟨CX.mul q.a s, CX.mul q.b s⟩

def Qubit.init (a b : CX) : Qubit := Qubit.normalize ⟨a, b⟩

def Qubit.initBasis0 : Qubit := ⟨CX.mk 1.0 0.0, CX.mk 0.0 0.0⟩

def Qubit.initBasis1 : Qubit := ⟨CX.mk 0.0 0.0, CX.mk 1.0 0.0⟩

def Qubit.prob0 (q : Qubit) : Float :=
  Float.clamp01 (q.a.re * q.a.re + q.a.im * q.a.im)

def Qubit.prob1 (q : Qubit) : Float :=
  Float.clamp01 (q.b.re * q.b.re + q.b.im * q.b.im)

structure NodeMeta where
  key   : String
  value : String
deriving Repr, BEq

structure Node where
  id       : String
  data     : String
  qubit    : Qubit
  phase    : Float
  metadata : List NodeMeta
deriving Repr

def Node.mk' (id data : String) (q : Qubit) (phase : Float) : Node :=
  ⟨id, data, q, phase, []⟩

def Node.setMetadata (n : Node) (k v : String) : Node :=
  let filtered := n.metadata.filter (fun m => m.key != k)
  { n with metadata := filtered ++ [⟨k, v⟩] }

def Node.getMetadata (n : Node) (k : String) : Option String :=
  (n.metadata.find? (fun m => m.key == k)).map (fun m => m.value)

structure EdgeMeta where
  key   : String
  value : String
deriving Repr, BEq

structure Edge where
  source              : String
  target              : String
  quality             : EdgeQuality
  weight              : Float
  quantum_correlation : CX
  fractal_dimension   : Float
  metadata            : List EdgeMeta
deriving Repr

def Edge.mk' (source target : String) (quality : EdgeQuality)
    (weight : Float) (qc : CX) (fd : Float) : Edge :=
  ⟨source, target, quality, weight, qc, fd, []⟩

def Edge.setMetadata (e : Edge) (k v : String) : Edge :=
  let filtered := e.metadata.filter (fun m => m.key != k)
  { e with metadata := filtered ++ [⟨k, v⟩] }

def Edge.getMetadata (e : Edge) (k : String) : Option String :=
  (e.metadata.find? (fun m => m.key == k)).map (fun m => m.value)

def Edge.correlationMagnitude (e : Edge) : Float :=
  Float.sqrt' (e.quantum_correlation.re * e.quantum_correlation.re +
               e.quantum_correlation.im * e.quantum_correlation.im)

structure TwoQubit where
  amps : Fin 4 → CX
deriving Repr

def TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus : TwoQubit :=
  let inv_sqrt2 : Float := 1.0 / Float.sqrt' 2.0
  ⟨fun i =>
    match i with
    | ⟨0, _⟩ => CX.mk inv_sqrt2 0.0
    | ⟨1, _⟩ => CX.mk 0.0 0.0
    | ⟨2, _⟩ => CX.mk 0.0 0.0
    | ⟨3, _⟩ => CX.mk inv_sqrt2 0.0
    | ⟨n+4, h⟩ => absurd h (Nat.not_succ_le_self _)⟩

def hadamardGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let inv_sqrt2 : Float := 1.0 / Float.sqrt' 2.0
  let s := CX.mk inv_sqrt2 0.0
  let a := CX.mul (CX.add q.a q.b) s
  let b := CX.mul (CX.sub q.a q.b) s
  Qubit.init a b

def pauliXGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit := Qubit.init q.b q.a

def pauliYGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let i_c     := CX.mk 0.0 1.0
  let minus_i := CX.mk 0.0 (-1.0)
  Qubit.init (CX.mul minus_i q.b) (CX.mul i_c q.a)

def pauliZGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  Qubit.init q.a (CX.mul q.b (CX.mk (-1.0) 0.0))

def identityGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit := q

def phaseGate (phase : Float) : Qubit → Qubit :=
  fun q =>
    let factor := CX.mk phase.cos phase.sin
    Qubit.init q.a (CX.mul q.b factor)

structure PairKey where
  a : String
  b : String
deriving Repr, BEq, Hashable

structure GraphState where
  nodes            : Std.HashMap String Node
  edges            : Std.HashMap (String × String) (List Edge)
  entanglements    : Std.HashMap PairKey TwoQubit
  quantumRegister  : Std.HashMap String Qubit
  topologyHash     : String
  rngState         : UInt64

def simpleHash (seed : UInt64) (s : String) : UInt64 :=
  s.foldl (fun acc c => acc * 6364136223846793005 + c.toNat.toUInt64 + 1442695040888963407) seed

def hashPair (a b : String) : UInt64 :=
  simpleHash (simpleHash 0 a) b

def computeTopologyHash (g : GraphState) : String :=
  let nodeH := g.nodes.fold (fun acc k v =>
    let h := simpleHash (simpleHash (simpleHash 0 k) v.data) v.id
    acc ^^^ h) 0
  let edgeH := g.edges.fold (fun acc (k : String × String) v =>
    let h := simpleHash (simpleHash 0 k.1) k.2
    let h2 := v.foldl (fun a e => a ^^^ simpleHash (simpleHash 0 e.source) e.target) h
    acc ^^^ h2) 0
  let entH := g.entanglements.fold (fun acc pk _ =>
    acc ^^^ simpleHash (simpleHash 0 pk.a) pk.b) 0
  let combined := nodeH ^^^ edgeH ^^^ entH
  s!"{combined}"

def GraphState.empty : GraphState :=
  let g : GraphState := {
    nodes           := Std.HashMap.empty
    edges           := Std.HashMap.empty
    entanglements   := Std.HashMap.empty
    quantumRegister := Std.HashMap.empty
    topologyHash    := ""
    rngState        := 12345678901234567
  }
  { g with topologyHash := computeTopologyHash g }

def GraphState.addNode (g : GraphState) (node : Node) : GraphState :=
  let g2 := { g with
    nodes           := g.nodes.insert node.id node
    quantumRegister := g.quantumRegister.insert node.id node.qubit
  }
  { g2 with topologyHash := computeTopologyHash g2 }

def GraphState.addEdge (g : GraphState) (source target : String) (edge : Edge) : Option GraphState :=
  match g.nodes.find? source, g.nodes.find? target with
  | none, _ => none
  | _, none => none
  | some _, some _ =>
    let key := (source, target)
    let stored := { edge with source := source, target := target }
    let existing := g.edges.findD key []
    let g2 := { g with edges := g.edges.insert key (existing ++ [stored]) }
    some { g2 with topologyHash := computeTopologyHash g2 }

def GraphState.getNode (g : GraphState) (id : String) : Option Node :=
  g.nodes.find? id

def GraphState.getEdges (g : GraphState) (source target : String) : List Edge :=
  g.edges.findD (source, target) []

def GraphState.clear (g : GraphState) : GraphState :=
  let g2 : GraphState := {
    nodes           := Std.HashMap.empty
    edges           := Std.HashMap.empty
    entanglements   := Std.HashMap.empty
    quantumRegister := Std.HashMap.empty
    topologyHash    := ""
    rngState        := g.rngState
  }
  { g2 with topologyHash := computeTopologyHash g2 }

def GraphState.setQuantumState (g : GraphState) (nodeId : String) (q : Qubit) : Option GraphState :=
  match g.nodes.find? nodeId with
  | none => none
  | some n =>
    let updated := { n with qubit := q }
    let g2 := { g with
      nodes           := g.nodes.insert nodeId updated
      quantumRegister := g.quantumRegister.insert nodeId q
    }
    some { g2 with topologyHash := computeTopologyHash g2 }

def GraphState.getQuantumState (g : GraphState) (nodeId : String) : Option Qubit :=
  g.quantumRegister.find? nodeId

def GraphState.applyGate (g : GraphState) (nodeId : String) (gate : Qubit → Qubit) : Option GraphState :=
  match g.nodes.find? nodeId with
  | none => none
  | some n =>
    let newQ := gate n.qubit
    let updated := { n with qubit := newQ }
    let g2 := { g with
      nodes           := g.nodes.insert nodeId updated
      quantumRegister := g.quantumRegister.insert nodeId newQ
    }
    some { g2 with topologyHash := computeTopologyHash g2 }

def GraphState.nodeCount (g : GraphState) : Nat := g.nodes.size

def GraphState.edgeCount (g : GraphState) : Nat :=
  g.edges.fold (fun acc _ v => acc + v.length) 0

def GraphState.rngNext (g : GraphState) : GraphState × Float :=
  let s := g.rngState * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407
  let f : Float := (s.toNat % 1000000).toFloat / 1000000.0
  ({ g with rngState := s }, f)

def GraphState.entangleNodes (g : GraphState) (aId bId : String) : Option GraphState :=
  match g.nodes.find? aId, g.nodes.find? bId with
  | none, _ => none
  | _, none => none
  | some _, some _ =>
    let pk : PairKey :=
      if aId < bId then ⟨aId, bId⟩ else ⟨bId, aId⟩
    let g2 := { g with entanglements := g.entanglements.insert pk TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus }
    let eab := Edge.mk' aId bId .entangled 1.0 (CX.mk 1.0 0.0) 0.0
    let eba := Edge.mk' bId aId .entangled 1.0 (CX.mk 1.0 0.0) 0.0
    let g3 := match GraphState.addEdge g2 aId bId eab with
      | none => g2
      | some x => x
    let g4 := match GraphState.addEdge g3 bId aId eba with
      | none => g3
      | some x => x
    some { g4 with topologyHash := computeTopologyHash g4 }

def GraphState.measure (g : GraphState) (nodeId : String) : Option (GraphState × Nat) :=
  match g.nodes.find? nodeId with
  | none => none
  | some _ =>
    let entPair := g.entanglements.fold (fun acc pk tq =>
      match acc with
      | some _ => acc
      | none =>
        if pk.a == nodeId || pk.b == nodeId then some (pk, tq) else none) none
    match entPair with
    | some (pk, state) =>
      let (g2, r) := GraphState.rngNext g
      let outcome : Nat :=
        let p0 := CX.normSq (state.amps ⟨0, by omega⟩)
        let p1 := p0 + CX.normSq (state.amps ⟨1, by omega⟩)
        let p2 := p1 + CX.normSq (state.amps ⟨2, by omega⟩)
        if r <= p0 then 0
        else if r <= p1 then 1
        else if r <= p2 then 2
        else 3
      let qa : Qubit := if outcome == 0 || outcome == 1 then Qubit.initBasis0 else Qubit.initBasis1
      let qb : Qubit := if outcome == 0 || outcome == 2 then Qubit.initBasis0 else Qubit.initBasis1
      let nA := g2.nodes.find? pk.a
      let nB := g2.nodes.find? pk.b
      let g3 := match nA with
        | none => g2
        | some n => { g2 with
            nodes           := g2.nodes.insert pk.a { n with qubit := qa }
            quantumRegister := g2.quantumRegister.insert pk.a qa }
      let g4 := match nB with
        | none => g3
        | some n => { g3 with
            nodes           := g3.nodes.insert pk.b { n with qubit := qb }
            quantumRegister := g3.quantumRegister.insert pk.b qb }
      let g5 := { g4 with entanglements := g4.entanglements.erase pk }
      let collapseEdge (gs : GraphState) (s t : String) : GraphState :=
        match gs.edges.find? (s, t) with
        | none => gs
        | some [] => gs
        | some (e :: rest) =>
          { gs with edges := gs.edges.insert (s, t) ({ e with quality := .collapsed } :: rest) }
      let g6 := collapseEdge g5 pk.a pk.b
      let g7 := collapseEdge g6 pk.b pk.a
      let bit : Nat := if nodeId == pk.a then (outcome / 2) % 2 else outcome % 2
      let g8 := { g7 with topologyHash := computeTopologyHash g7 }
      some (g8, bit)
    | none =>
      let (g2, r) := GraphState.rngNext g
      match g2.nodes.find? nodeId with
      | none => none
      | some n =>
        let p0 := n.qubit.prob0
        let bit : Nat := if r <= p0 then 0 else 1
        let newQ := if bit == 0 then Qubit.initBasis0 else Qubit.initBasis1
        let g3 := { g2 with
          nodes           := g2.nodes.insert nodeId { n with qubit := newQ }
          quantumRegister := g2.quantumRegister.insert nodeId newQ
        }
        some ({ g3 with topologyHash := computeTopologyHash g3 }, bit)

def GraphState.encodeInformation (g : GraphState) (data : String) : GraphState × String :=
  let nodeId := s!"enc_{data.length}_{simpleHash 0 data}"
  let node := Node.mk' nodeId data Qubit.initBasis0 0.0
  let g2 := GraphState.addNode g node
  let allIds := g2.nodes.fold (fun acc k _ => acc ++ [k]) []
  let otherIds := allIds.filter (fun id => id != nodeId)
  let maxLinks := Nat.min (otherIds.length) 3
  let linkedIds := otherIds.reverse.take maxLinks
  let g3 := linkedIds.foldl (fun gs prevId =>
    let e := Edge.mk' nodeId prevId .coherent 0.5 (CX.mk 0.0 0.0) 0.0
    match GraphState.addEdge gs nodeId prevId e with
    | none => gs
    | some x => x) g2
  ({ g3 with topologyHash := computeTopologyHash g3 }, nodeId)

def GraphState.decodeInformation (g : GraphState) (nodeId : String) : Option String :=
  (g.nodes.find? nodeId).map (fun n => n.data)

def GraphState.getTopologyHashHex (g : GraphState) : String :=
  g.topologyHash

def GraphState.getAllNodeIds (g : GraphState) : List String :=
  let ids := g.nodes.fold (fun acc k _ => acc ++ [k]) []
  ids.mergeSort (fun a b => a < b)

def GraphState.exportNodeEmbeddings (g : GraphState) : List (List Float) :=
  g.nodes.fold (fun acc _ node =>
    acc ++ [[node.qubit.a.re, node.qubit.a.im, node.qubit.b.re, node.qubit.b.im]]) []

def GraphState.importNodeEmbeddings (g : GraphState) (embeddings : List (String × List Float)) : GraphState :=
  let g2 := embeddings.foldl (fun gs (nodeId, emb) =>
    match gs.nodes.find? nodeId, emb with
    | none, _ => gs
    | some n, (are :: aim :: bre :: bim :: _) =>
      let newQ : Qubit := ⟨CX.mk are aim, CX.mk bre bim⟩
      { gs with
        nodes           := gs.nodes.insert nodeId { n with qubit := newQ }
        quantumRegister := gs.quantumRegister.insert nodeId newQ }
    | some _, _ => gs) g
  { g2 with topologyHash := computeTopologyHash g2 }

def GraphState.exportAdjacencyMatrix (g : GraphState) (nodeIds : List String) : List (List Float) :=
  nodeIds.map (fun src =>
    nodeIds.map (fun tgt =>
      let edges := g.edges.findD (src, tgt) []
      edges.length.toFloat))

theorem CX.add_comm (a b : CX) : CX.add a b = CX.add b a :=
  show ⟨a.re + b.re, a.im + b.im⟩ = ⟨b.re + a.re, b.im + a.im⟩ from
    congrArg₂ CX.mk (Float.add_comm a.re b.re) (Float.add_comm a.im b.im)

theorem CX.add_assoc (a b c : CX) : CX.add (CX.add a b) c = CX.add a (CX.add b c) :=
  show ⟨a.re + b.re + c.re, a.im + b.im + c.im⟩ = ⟨a.re + (b.re + c.re), a.im + (b.im + c.im)⟩ from
    congrArg₂ CX.mk (Float.add_assoc a.re b.re c.re) (Float.add_assoc a.im b.im c.im)

theorem CX.normSq_nonneg (c : CX) : 0.0 ≤ CX.normSq c :=
  show 0.0 ≤ c.re * c.re + c.im * c.im from

theorem CX.mul_comm (a b : CX) : CX.mul a b = CX.mul b a :=
  show ⟨a.re * b.re - a.im * b.im, a.re * b.im + a.im * b.re⟩ =
       ⟨b.re * a.re - b.im * a.im, b.re * a.im + b.im * a.re⟩ from
    congrArg₂ CX.mk
      (show a.re * b.re - a.im * b.im = b.re * a.re - b.im * a.im from
        congrArg₂ (· - ·) (Float.mul_comm a.re b.re) (Float.mul_comm a.im b.im))
      (show a.re * b.im + a.im * b.re = b.re * a.im + b.im * a.re from
        Eq.trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (Float.mul_comm a.re b.im) (Float.mul_comm a.im b.re))
                 (Float.add_comm (b.im * a.re) (b.re * a.im) |>.symm |>
                   fun _ => congrArg₂ (· + ·) (Float.mul_comm b.re a.im) (Float.mul_comm b.im a.re)))
